name: Baaya
source: She is the Fortuneteller that Tsuyoshi visits regularly to ask for advice to what path he must follow. She has the  habit to scream in the face of Tsuyoshi before making her predictions.
translation: She is the Fortuneteller that Tsuyoshi visits regularly to ask for advice to what path he must follow. She has the  habit to scream in the face of Tsuyoshi before making her predictions.
